newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent products prices track NYMEX drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent products prices track NYMEX drop.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices eased late Wednesday, tracking the drop in NYMEX futures prices, traders said.

Weaker differentials on diesel barrels contributed to the weaker basis, which was fueled largely by a more than two cent a gallon drop in NYMEX front-month heating oil and nearly one cent drop in unleaded gasoline futures prices.
"The (NYMEX) market was ripe for some profit taking," one trader said of the anticipated October peak in heating oil futures, which translated into lower spot prices in Chicago and Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel for October deliveries remained 2.50/2.25 cents a gallon under the print for October deliveries in Chicago, and even to 0.25 cent over the print in Group Three.
High sulphur diesel was steady at 4.25 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 2.0 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three after easing early in the day.
Unleaded gasoline differentials were steady in both markets, traders said.
Trade in spot barrels was thinned by an industry gathering in Texas that pulled some players out of the market.
